newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal investment by Grohe approved.
newsitem.headline: Portugal investment by Grohe approved.

text.p: The cabinet approved an investment contract between the Portuguese state and German company Grohe AG for the installation of a tap factory in Portugal, a spokesman said.
He told reporters that the total investment of six billion escudos ($39.2 million) until 1999 would include 400 million escudos for training and the creation of 255 jobs.
He said the location of the factory had not been decided.
Diario Economico newspaper reported last month that the factory, due to start producing taps for export in 1998, could be established in Albergaria-A-Velha near Aveiro in north Portugal.
The spokesman said the government would provide financial incentives to Grohe but he gave no details.
